claims.claim: Leyndell's Avenue Balcony, Dragon Wing, West Capital Rampart, Fortified Manor and Divine Bridge form a layered legacy-dungeon route. The Divine Bridge is reached through the Fortified Manor elevator; the sending gate to the Isolated Divine Tower is a separate one-way plane transition. V1 adds only the documented walk/elevator returns and keeps the elevator return conditional on the activated bridge state.

The Avenue Balcony entrance descends into Underground Roadside; the sewer then branches through pipes, ladders and a cage lift toward Forsaken Depths and Leyndell Catacombs. Those branches can be represented as returns to the upper sewer junction, while the surface ascent is kept as a high-risk layer transition rather than a flat same-floor edge.

Mohg, the Omen must be defeated before the Cathedral of the Forsaken grace exists; the Frenzied Flame Proscription descent requires the post-boss and Morgott state and remains a high-risk one-way descent. V1 adds the post-boss return to Forsaken Depths without inventing a reverse edge for the beam parkour or the Divine Bridge sending gate.
